title: Pip and the Gap
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters dr, fl, fr.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing beside a large gap in a wooden garden fence.
Pip looking at the gap in the fence, which will not close.
Pip the sparrow flying off to search the garden for something useful.
Pip spotting a flat brown stick lying in the grass.
Pip the sparrow carrying the flat brown stick back in his beak.
Pip the sparrow fitting the brown stick into the gap in the fence.
The gap in the wooden fence now closed up with the brown stick.
Pip the sparrow clapping his wings together, delighted.
Pip the sparrow resting contentedly beside the mended fence gap.
